violations.text: Egg and chourico observed held at 130 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Hot hold unit observed with shallow pans and the water level was well below the pans. More water was added to unit to increase hot holding temperatures. Egg and chourico were reheated to proper temperatures and returned to the hot hold unit. Temperatures are to be frequently checked to ensure safe hot holding temperatures. Hot hold logs are to be sent to inspector. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/24/2026

Cooked eggs were observed held at 115 - 119 degrees Fahrenheit in a storage pan on top of the small oven unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be maintained at 135 degrees Fahrenheit or above except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. As the eggs were not able to be reheated/recooked to 165 degrees F, they were voluntarily disposed of during inspection. Proper hot holding unit available on-site. Eggs may be stored on this unit if it maintains food temperatures at/above 135 degrees F. Food temperatures must be carefully monitored. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Sandwich meats and condiments observed held at 50 - 52 degrees Fahrenheit in a counter cold hold unit. Stainless pans in this unit are unable to be surrounded by ice due to lack of space. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods were out of temperature control for 1 hour and were moved to properly functioning lowboy unit. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Spray bottle used for storing chemicals taken from bulk supplies was not marked with the common name of the chemical. Spray bottle was labeled during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Working containers of dry ingredients (such as salt, sugar, houjicha, cinnamon) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. Containers were labeled during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026

Pastries observed on display at the service counter without a proper sneeze guard. All foods must be protected from contamination by consumers and staff. Proper sneeze guard is to be installed. New Violation. Correct By: 11/27/2026

Staff were observed not wearing hair restraints. Food employees must wear hair restraints such as hats, hair coverings, or nets that are worn to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment/utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. New Violation. Correct By: 11/12/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dishwasher. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2026
Establishment must post an allergen statement. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The facility is lacking test strips to measure the concentration of the quaternary ammonium sanitizing solution for the 3-bay sink. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dishwasher. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The door restroom is not self-closing. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
The downstairs small food storage area is lacking overhead protection. Covering/ceiling must be installed using approved material. New Violation. Correct By: 06/22/2026
